items.title: Pete Hegseth honors soldier who scolded him at Arlington cemetery
items.titleOrig: Pete Hegseth honors soldier who scolded him at Arlington cemetery
items.desc: The soldier had reprimanded the US Defense Secretary and his group after they were heard talking and laughing at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. The site is one of the most solemn military memorials in the US.

items.title: Nigeria: Axe-wielding men attack opposition campaign rally in Lagos
items.titleOrig: Nigeria: Axe-wielding men attack opposition campaign rally in Lagos
items.desc: A group of men armed with axes, clubs and machetes have reportedly attacked an opposition rally in the run-up to presidential elections. Journalists were also attacked as victims pointed fingers at the ruling APC party.

items.title: Czechia braces for massive protest as anger over government's public media reform plans boils
items.titleOrig: Czechia braces for massive protest as anger over government's public media reform plans boils
items.desc: A fast-tracked bill on public media funding reform has sparked strikes, rallies and fears for the independence of public broadcasting in Czechia. A massive protest is due to take place in Prague on November 15.

items.title: Can the EU make it harder to trick consumers online?
items.titleOrig: Can the EU make it harder to trick consumers online?
items.desc: The EU wants to curb subscription traps, misleading sales tactics and features that keep people scrolling. What would the proposed Digital Fairness Act change, and does it go far enough?

items.title: Mercedes-Benz halts all further investment at German facilities
items.titleOrig: Mercedes-Benz halts all further investment at German facilities
items.desc: The announcement comes as the luxury German automaker faces increasing pressure from the works council and trade unions.

items.title: What have the talks with Russia and the US in Abu Dhabi achieved for Ukraine?
items.titleOrig: What have the talks with Russia and the US in Abu Dhabi achieved for Ukraine?
items.desc: The first trilateral talks between Ukraine, the US and Russia in nine months have ended with an agreement on exchanging prisoners. Does this mark a genuine breakthrough and a step toward peace?

items.title: Hungary eases abortion restrictions in women's rights overhaul
items.titleOrig: Hungary eases abortion restrictions in women's rights overhaul
items.desc: The reforms mark a break the the conservative policies of former PM Viktor Orban. The controversial "heartbeat regulation" is to be scrapped and women are to be better protected against violence.

items.title: Sri Lanka: Rights groups sound alarm over proposed anti-terror law
items.titleOrig: Sri Lanka: Rights groups sound alarm over proposed anti-terror law
items.desc: The Sri Lankan government is looking to replace a controversial anti-terror law, but critics say the new one is just as bad.

items.title: UK court convicts 2 Iranian men of spying on journalists
items.titleOrig: UK court convicts 2 Iranian men of spying on journalists
items.desc: A London court has found two Iranian citizens guilty of surveilling reporters for a Persian-language television station critical of Iran's government. One was also convicted of planning a violent attack against them.

items.title: Impeachment: How it works and why Trump should be worried
items.titleOrig: Impeachment: How it works and why Trump should be worried
items.desc: Pete Hegseth, Bill Clinton and Donald Trump (twice so far): attempts to impeach political figures are becoming common. The failure rate looks high, but according to experts, conviction is not always the aim.

items.title: Jensen Huang: Spy row, second affair leaves Nvidia without its rockstar CEO
items.titleOrig: Jensen Huang: Spy row, second affair leaves Nvidia without its rockstar CEO

items.title: Iran: Exiled journalists still repressed by regime
items.titleOrig: Iran: Exiled journalists still repressed by regime
items.desc: For many independent reporters, leaving Iran does not mean fully escaping the grasp of the Iranian state. The regime uses family members, bank accounts and the property they left behind to apply pressure across borders.

items.titleOrig: China's Xi Jinping renews calls for 'reunification' with Taiwan
